VirtualHost configuration:
192.0.2.10:80          is a NameVirtualHost
         default server www.alice.example (/usr/local/directadmin/data/users/alice/httpd.conf:4)
         port 80 namevhost www.alice.example (/usr/local/directadmin/data/users/alice/httpd.conf:4)
                 alias www.alice.example
                 alias alice.example
         port 80 namevhost www.blog.alice.example (/usr/local/directadmin/data/users/alice/httpd.conf:26)
                 alias www.blog.alice.example
                 alias blog.alice.example
         port 80 namevhost www.carol.example (/usr/local/directadmin/data/users/carol/httpd.conf:1)
                 alias www.carol.example
                 alias carol.example
